violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Employee observed not washing hands after handling money and moving from task to task.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth found in kitchen not stored in a proper sanitizing solution.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Inside of the microwave the paint/coating is starting to flake and leaving exposed metal to oxidize.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The inside of the ice machine is starting to show buildup of debris and is in need of a detail clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Utensils on shelving in back room were discovered inside of a cardboard box. Utensils should be stored on a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.

Handling of clean equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not handled in a manner to prevent contamination of food-contact surface. Container of clean utensils in back room has utensil handles facing different ways. Utensils need to be handled the same direction to reduce risk of contamination to food contact surfaces.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Food employee did not wash her hands before putting on gloves. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Microwave in the back kitchen was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employee's opened beverage was found near the drink preparation area. Employee personal items should be stored separated from items used in food preparation for the facility.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Utensils were found stored in a dirty bin in the back kitchen. Clean utensils and equipment should be stored in a clean location.
